name: My Affection that Dies
source:
My girlfriend committed suicide, but I couldn't bring myself to touch her dead body. Then the world collapsed, and she revived as a zombie.


This story is a tragedy. Therefore, there is no happy ending.

[From [url=https://4noki.itch.io/my-affection-that-dies]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我的女朋友自杀了，但我无法让自己触摸她的尸体。然后世界崩溃了，她复活成了僵尸。


这个故事是一个悲剧。因此，没有幸福的结局。

[来自[url=https://4noki.itch.io/my-affection-that-dies]itch.io[/url]]
